tournament.local.desc.text: A friendly one day event for the area. A good first step up the ladder.

tournament.regional.desc.text: Two days of play with a bigger field from across the region.

tournament.national.desc.text: Three days of play and real crowds. Your course is judged against the best in the country.

tournament.major.desc.text: Four days, the strongest field and the biggest stage in the game.
